# ADR-002: QR ticket auto-generation hook — synchronous call, not webhook

## Status
Accepted

## Context

A QR ticket must be auto-generated every time someone registers for an
event. Registration is created in Hasan's module, ticket generation
lives in this module. Two real options were considered: a webhook, or a
simple synchronous fetch() call. Neither the module spec nor the full
build spec PDF mandates a specific architecture — only the outcome,
"auto-generated on each registration."

## Decision

Use a simple synchronous call: Hasan's registration handler calls this
module's POST /api/v1/tickets/generate directly via fetch(), right
after creating a registration, before returning its own response.

## Consequences

- Positive: fastest to implement, no webhook receiver or retry logic needed
- Positive: spec-compliant, since the spec never mandated an architecture
- Negative: tightly coupled — if this module's endpoint is slow or down,
  it directly affects Hasan's registration response
- Negative: no shared auth exists yet between modules, acceptable for
  now but must be revisited before production
- Future: can be upgraded to an async webhook/queue system later
